title: Text content sent as a CBOR byte string

source.note: composed: the mirror image of 06 — raw bytes under a `text` format. §5.1.4 says the content "must be represented as specified by the format", which for text is a string, so this decodes and validate reports an Error.

notes: The other case where canonical_json is not a fixed point: the bytes are re-encoded as the base64 string `SGVsbG8=`, which on the JSON wire is a string and so raises no finding at all. The bytes are UTF-8 for "Hello" and could in principle be decoded as text; the crate does not, because a byte string is not a text string and guessing the encoding is the sender's job.
